description.zh: 直接连接 DSH 运行时的轻量快速终端界面插件。
description.en: A lightweight and fast terminal interface plugin connected directly to the DSH runtime.

description.zh: 在输入框统计行里、原生缓存命中读数之后显示计费时段与账户余额：高峰/非高峰圆点与切换倒计时，点击展开面板，按接口返回的货币拆分总额、赠送与充值。
description.en: Billing season and account balance in the composer statistics row, right after the cache-hit reading: a peak/off-peak dot with a countdown to the next switch, and a panel splitting the balance into total, granted and topped up in the currency the API reports.
